subject: [AMBER] extraction of ph specific trajectory from constant ph replica exchange

messages.author: Dulal Mondal
messages.body:
Dear Experts,
I use the following command to extract the ph specific trajectory.
for i in {001..025};do echo trajin ../../001/nc.rep.$i remdtraj
remdtrajtemp 5.0 trajnames
../../002/nc.rep.$i,../../003/nc.rep.$i,../../004/nc.rep.$i,../../005/nc.rep.$i,../../006/nc.rep.$i,../../007/nc.rep.$i,../../008/nc.rep.$i,../../009/nc.rep.$i,../../010/nc.rep.$i>
1.in;echo trajout prod$i.nc netcdf >2.in;cat 1.in 2.in > traj$i.in;cpptraj
-p ../../amber18.prmtop -i traj$i.in;done
But this does not work in amber24.
-- 
*With regards,*
*Dulal Mondal,*
*Research Scholar,*
*Department of Chemistry,*
*IIT Kharagpur, Kharagpur 721302.*

messages.author: Daniel Roe
messages.body:
I'm not sure if there was a problem with your message formatting, but
it wasn't clear if the input you posted was intended to be a shell
script or cpptraj input.
On Mon, Nov 11, 2024 at 8:21 AM Dulal Mondal via AMBER
<amber.ambermd.org> wrote:
> But this does not work in amber24.
This is too vague for anyone to begin helping you. You should be as
specific as possible as to what errors/warnings/behavior you are
seeing. You can't go wrong pasting or attaching the entire output you
get from cpptraj. As always, make sure you are reading the entire
manual entry for any commands you are using to ensure you are using
them properly.
-Dan
